mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_like (like_id, target_type, target_id, user_id, user_type, source_url, menu_id, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{likeId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{userType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{menuId}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE delete_yn = IF(delete_yn = 'Y', 'N', 'Y'), source_url = VALUES(source_url), updated_by = VALUES(created_by), updated_ip = VALUES(created_ip), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT delete_yn FROM tb_bbs_like WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_like WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_article a SET a.like_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_like l WHERE l.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND l.target_id = a.article_id AND l.delete_yn = 'N'), a.updated_at = a.updated_at WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId}

UPDATE tb_bbs_comment c SET c.like_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_like l WHERE l.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND l.target_id = c.comment_id AND l.delete_yn = 'N'), c.updated_at = c.updated_at WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
